Phase-20.NAME: ForkStateCleanup
Phase-20.purpose: Remove remaining accidental Reasonix fork drift from MAGRA user-facing, release, desktop, and storage surfaces while preserving explicit upstream attribution and compatibility aliases.

steps.step-1: Define cleanup boundaries: old naming allowed only in attribution, source-analysis, and explicit compatibility surfaces.
steps.step-2: Rewrite high-visibility CLI, dashboard, and feedback text so MAGRA is primary user-facing identity.
steps.step-3: Clean GitHub issue templates, workflow labels, and release-facing URLs to MAGRA-first values.
steps.step-4: Refresh desktop user-visible identity while deferring risky bundle-id migration until a dedicated follow-up wave.
steps.step-5: Migrate canonical project/config memory paths from REASONIX to MAGRA naming with safe transition reads.
steps.step-6: Reconcile update/package alias surfaces so MAGRA is canonical and legacy aliases remain explicit compatibility shims.
steps.step-7: Run MyGRACE lint, focused release/feedback tests, build, typecheck, and full verification.
